title: wg: protocol-06 hub's own credential identity unspecified
description: Suggestion. The hub signs as external sender, franking agent and hub_sender (groupInfo responses), but the spec never states what its BasicCredential identity is. mimid uses mimi://<hub domain> (decision mimid-1wgh.6.35). Fix: specify it.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY. Not silent: §4.2 TODO + franking domain check; gap is credential type/identity for external sender, franking agent, hub_sender. New issue, merge with 37.67.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/150
